steps.note: A tag census over a corpus.
The dangling-author rule joins the `authors` view; the page quotes `✗ 1 row — check failed`.
With no config, the same rule as a path self-join over bare inputs.
`--param author=ghost` binds a runtime value into the gate.
Name the gate in config: a bare `meta validate` runs the checks after the per-file schemas.
`--format json` prints the bare result array.
`--format csv` prints the same rows as CSV.
`--db <path>` writes the built table to a SQLite file.
`--dry-run` previews the UPDATE; the page quotes `reviewed: (unset) -> todo`.

scaffolding: docs/ (five pages with slug, author, tags, draft, and review fields: one cites the missing author `ghost`, two share a slug), authors/ (two author pages), schemas/author.json, and the page's manni.config.yaml declaring the `pages` and `authors` collections. The page has the reader move the duplicate-slug rule into `checks:`, so a spec rewrites the config before the bare validate.
